Alex D: Hey team — noticed our p95 for /v1/generate jumped retroactively for last 48h after the routing label backfill ran. historical charts look different :eyes:
Maria P: Wait you mean the data points that were already on the dashboard changed? that's bad
Alex D: yep, p50 barely moved but p95/p99 shifted up ~120ms across several older buckets
Kevin L: Could be the 'attribute backfill' that reassigns endpoint labels post-ingest. Our rollup merge is not stable for tdigest merges when sample attrs change
Sara I: infra note: we ran backfill at 1733332000. It reattributed ~18M samples from default->new-endpoint over 72h window. console-bot posted job success
console-bot: reingest-job INF-1423 completed (reassigned endpoint tags). affected: metrics latency.hist, samples: 18,013,256
Maria P: So why would merges change earlier percentiles? tdigests are mergeable but only if order/weights identical
Kevin L: Right. Our merge pipeline currently assumes attribute-hash immutability. When we swap labels, we do "in-place merge + overwrite" which can reorder intermediate centroids -> pct shifts
Alex D: Is the fix to re-reduce with stable deterministic merge? Or keep original sample-level records and recompute from raw? both expensive
Sara I: Short term: we can run a deterministic tdigest-merge pass for the backfilled partitions (INF-1424), cheaper than full re-reduce. Long term: store sample origin tag to avoid attr mutation
Maria P: For dashboard UX: we should flag reattributed windows with a badge and tooltip "historical metrics modified due to backfill" so product teams aren't surprised :thinking:
Kevin L: Agreed. Also add a backfill header in the query UI + link to job id. We should not silently rewrite pctl history
Alex D: can someone triage perf impact? p95 delta is large for customer-facing endpoints; might mask real regressions
Sara I: assigning Kevin + infra to measure perf and propose mitigation. I'll open INF-1424 and notify release lead
Kevin L: quick adhoc query I used:
```
SELECT quantile(0.95, latency_ms) AS p95
FROM metrics.latency
WHERE endpoint = '/v1/generate' AND time >= '2026-03-18' and time < '2026-03-20'
GROUP BY day
```
Alex D: thanks. I've added screenshots in the ticket. Also UX: can we add a 'backfill heatmap' overlay to compare pre/post
Maria P: tagging @sara to make sure the backfill window shows in dashboard legend
Sara I: noted. I'll push a small console change to show backfill ribbon + job link. target: next patch
Alex D: OK - next actions: (1) INF-1424 deterministic-merge pass (owner Kevin), (2) console ribbon + job link (owner Sara), (3) postmortem/ticket explanation + communication (owner Maria). I'll follow up later today :thumbsup:
console-bot: ticket INF-1424 created by Kevin L
Kevin L: starting analysis now, will post preliminary numbers in #eng-platform later
Maria P: thanks all :heart:
